decks.notes: The deck aims to quickly set up and protect Lotus Field to generate massive amounts of mana, which allows for explosive combos using cards like Hidden Strings and Emergent Ultimatum to search for win conditions like Omniscience or Behold the Beyond. The deck utilizes cards like Impulse, Pore Over the Pages, and Thespian's Stage to dig through the deck and find key pieces. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures and Lair of the Hydra provides protection and additional win conditions. With careful resource management and strategic planning, the deck can execute devastating combos to overwhelm opponents.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells, removal, and hand disruption while generating card advantage through cards like Dig Through Time and Memory Deluge. The deck also aims to control the board with cards like Shark Typhoon and The Meathook Massacre, and eventually win the game through efficient threats like Ashiok, Nightmare Muse and Hall of Storm Giants. With a mix of permission, removal, and card advantage, the deck aims to stay in control of the game and outvalue the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to generate powerful creatures quickly and efficiently, while also utilizing a mix of counterspells and removal to control the board. It also incorporates card draw and token generation to provide flexibility and resilience in different matchups. By combining creativity and strategic decision-making, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with unexpected threats and disrupt their game plan effectively, leading to a swift victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing Omnath, Locus of Creation's abilities to ramp up mana and control the board through cards like Chained to the Rocks and Leyline Binding. With a variety of land cards and Bring to Light for versatility, the deck aims to have a strong late-game presence with threats like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The inclusion of a variety of companions and unique lands adds depth and flexibility to the deck's strategy, allowing for adaptability in different matchups.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to combo off and cheat out high-cost creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels. It also uses various spells and lands to control the game and protect the combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Divide by Zero and Negate helps disrupt the opponent's strategy while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and other spells provide card advantage and additional ways to find the combo pieces. The deck is designed to be creative in its approach to winning the game quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats, and generating card advantage. It utilizes a combination of counterspells like Negate and Divide by Zero, removal spells like Anger of the Gods and Spikefield Hazard, and card draw spells like Dig Through Time and Alrund's Epiphany. The deck also includes versatile cards like Fading Hope and Make Disappear to deal with various threats. The win condition is to either control the game until the opponent runs out of resources or to generate value with cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Chandra, Hope's Beacon.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of removal, disruption, and creatures that provide pressure on the opponent. It aims to control the board early with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while applying pressure with powerful threats such as Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck also utilizes lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear to generate additional value. With a combination of efficient removal and impactful creatures, the deck looks to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Blightstep Pathway. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck combines aggressive creatures with removal spells to maintain board control and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Sulfurous Springs and Castle Locthwain ensures that the deck can consistently cast its spells and maintain its aggressive game plan. With a blend of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on using Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Eldritch Evolution to quickly assemble the combo with Parhelion II. Thoughtseize and Duress help disrupt opponents' game plans, while Satyr Wayfinder helps find key pieces. Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot provide additional threats and value. The mana base is streamlined to support the combo and ensure consistency. Professor of Symbology and Raffine's Informant provide card advantage and selection. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, board wiping with Supreme Verdict, and generating card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck also includes a powerful finisher in Shark Typhoon and has utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Ardenvale. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion provides additional value by giving all creatures in the deck vigilance. Overall, the strategy revolves around disrupting the opponent's game plan and outlasting them in a war of attrition.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push to clear the way for aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. It also has ways to generate card advantage and pressure the opponent's life total with cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser. The deck aims to apply early pressure while controlling the board with strong threats and removal spells to secure the win.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Lotus Field with multiple untap effects, such as Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This mana is then used to play powerful spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum to either win the game or establish a dominant board position. The deck also includes card draw and tutoring effects to find the combo pieces efficiently. It aims to disrupt opponents with counter magic and removal while setting up its own game-winning plays.
